_help: Every ad on the website comes from this file. Three kinds of spots: 'banner' (wide, 728x90 image: the homepage banner under 'Today at Schalmont' and the banner at the bottom of every page), 'square' (300x250-ish image: bottom of the left menu on every page, and the footer). Each ad: img (path to the image in images/Ads/...), href (where a click goes), name (the business, used for screen readers). Several ads in one spot take turns every 10 seconds. An empty list shows an 'Advertise with us' box.
